reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the CA-TRIP mechanism from crystal-glass nanolaminates (P27, P38) with the edge-dislocation-controlled plasticity of refractory HEAs (P29, P39) and applies it to a new system—FCC/BCC HEA multilayers under creep—proposing that lattice distortion and SRO drive interfacial amorphization, a combination no passage suggests. It also designs a falsification test comparing pre-diffused and sharp interfaces, which addresses a gap in understanding creep in HEA multilayers.

edge dislocation dominance in refractory HEAs (P29, P39)
crystalline-to-amorphous transformation (CA-TRIP) concept (P27, P31, P36, P38, P41)
